sources.note: Australian Catholic University's own page for the ACU Stipend Scholarship (recorded official_source_url; read directly via a browser session on 12 October 2026).

awarding_body.detail: The page is on acu.edu.au and is ACU's own scholarship page; it states the scholarship is offered and funded by the Australian Catholic University.
awarding_body.quote: The Australian Catholic University offers stipend scholarships to support domestic and international candidates undertaking a Research Doctorate or Research Masters degree.

deadline.detail: The page states the rounds run twice a year and lists only 2026 deadlines, both now past as of the check date: Round 1 'Wednesday 1 April 2026, 11:59 PM (AEDT)' and Round 2 'Thursday 1 October 2026, 11:59 PM (AEST)'. The record's '1 April 2027 (next round)' is consistent with the published twice-yearly April/October pattern but the page does not state any 2027 date, so that exact deadline cannot be confirmed from it. No cycle was open at check time.
deadline.quote: Applications open twice per annum in April and October.

eligibility.detail: Confirmed both claims: open to all applicants (domestic or overseas) and enrolled in an accredited research higher degree at ACU, with research aligned to ACU's broad areas of expertise.
eligibility.quote: A student must be a domestic student or an overseas student enrolled in an accredited research higher degree at ACU.

funding.detail: The award is fully funded: a living stipend plus a full fee offset, and an Overseas Student Health Care Policy and relocation allowance for international applicants.
funding.quote: Stipend scholarship of AUD $34,315* per annum (full-time) Full fee offset valued at approximately AUD $34,728 per annum

degree_levels.detail: The page offers the scholarship for a Research Doctorate or Research Masters degree (PhD and MPhil per ACU's graduate research pages), matching the record's 'PhD, Master's'.
degree_levels.quote: The Australian Catholic University offers stipend scholarships to support domestic and international candidates undertaking a Research Doctorate or Research Masters degree.
